description.es: Home Assistant (puerto 8123) con TLS, WebSocket (la interfaz y la app lo usan de forma permanente) y cabeceras X-Forwarded-*. En Home Assistant hay que activar http: use_x_forwarded_for y trusted_proxies con la IP de HAProxy; si no, rechaza las peticiones con 400.
description.en: Home Assistant (port 8123) with TLS, WebSocket (the UI and the app keep one open) and X-Forwarded-* headers. In Home Assistant you must enable http: use_x_forwarded_for and trusted_proxies with HAProxy's IP; otherwise it rejects requests with 400.

lines: http-check send meth GET uri / ver HTTP/1.1 hdr Host {{domain}}
